title: Gimlet Eye report
description: The result of one tool run. 1.0 shape: the envelope fields added in 1.1 (report_version, tool_version, generated_at, host) are optional and readers ignore fields they do not know.

tool.description: The tool id that produced the report, e.g. crypto.sha256.

status.description: Derived from the findings by the runtime, never declared by a tool.

data.description: Structured result; its shape is declared per tool in the manifest.

body.description: A rendering the tool produced itself; text and markdown prefer it over data.
